articles.title: Bitcoin drops to $80,000 on Fed dissent, Samsung, Alphabet earnings; AI tokens slump
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell 1.4% since midnight UTC to around $80,100 as disappointing reports from Samsung and Alphabet weighed on tech stocks. The Fed’s preferred inflation gauge is due later today.

articles.title: Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
articles.snippet: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests under proposed Bank of England guidance.

articles.title: Unlimit founder backs Phase blockchain with $45M as mainnet launches
articles.snippet: Phase’s new network lets smartphone owners earn tokens for validating transactions and sharing internet connections with AI agents.

articles.title: Coinbase seeks Brazil crypto license, expects no service disruption
articles.snippet: Coinbase has applied for authorization ahead of Brazil’s Oct. 30 deadline and says it expects to maintain existing services while regulators review its application.
